interfaces.description: List of IP addresses to bind the DNS resolver interface(s). Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4, :: for all IPv6.

server_port.description: Local port on which the resolver listens for DNS queries.

do_ip4.description: Enable IPv4 support for DNS queries and responses.

do_ip6.description: Enable IPv6 support for DNS queries and responses.

do_udp.description: Enable UDP transport for DNS queries and responses.

do_tcp.description: Enable TCP transport for DNS queries (required for large DNSSEC responses).

tcp_upstream.description: Maximum number of TCP connections allowed per upstream server.

tcp_downstream.description: Maximum number of TCP connections allowed per local interface.

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to auto-detect CPU count.

edns_buffer_size.description: EDNS buffer size in bytes (must be ≥ 512 and ≤ 4096 for best compatibility).

msg_cache_size.description: Size of the message cache. Supports suffixes like 'kb', 'mb', 'gb'.

msg_cache_slabs.description: Number of slabs in the message cache (power of two recommended for performance).

key_cache_size.description: Size of the DNSSEC key cache.

key_cache_slabs.description: Number of slabs in the key cache.

rrset_cache_size.description: Size of the RRSET (resource record set) cache.

rrset_cache_slabs.description: Number of slabs in the RRSET cache.

infra_cache_ttl.description: TTL for infrastructure cache entries (e.g., RTT info, hints), in seconds.

infra_cache_slabs.description: Number of slabs in the infrastructure cache.

log_queries.description: Log every incoming query (debugging use only; can generate large logs).

log_replies.description: Log every outgoing reply (debugging use only).

log_tag.description: Prefix log lines with thread number and time in ISO 8601 format.

log_time_ascii.description: Use human-readable ASCII timestamp in logs (instead of Unix epoch).

access_control.description: Access control list entries in format: `<subnet> <action>` (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24 allow_sld').

forward_upstream.description: List of forwarding zones. Each zone forwards queries for a domain suffix to upstream resolvers.

name.description: Domain name for this forward zone (e.g., '.' for global forward, 'example.com' for zone-specific).

forward_first.description: Try forward first; if no response, perform recursive resolution.

hosts.description: List of upstream resolver addresses (may include port: 'host@port').

auto_trust_anchor_file.description: File containing the auto-generated trust anchor (RFC 5011).

trust_anchor_files.description: List of static trust anchor files (e.g., IANA's root key).

trust_anchor_signing.description: Enable DNSSEC signing of local data (only if managing a signing zone).

username.description: User account under which the Unbound process runs after initialization.

local_zones.description: List of local zone definitions (e.g., stub zones, private domains, stub zones).

type.description: Zone behavior type: transparent, deny, reject, static, stub, always_transparent, nodefault, etc.

local_data.description: List of inline DNS records (RR data) in Unbound’s local-data format: `<name> <TTL> IN <type> <rdata>`. Example: 'myhost.example.local. 3600 IN A 192.168.1.10'.

statistics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for dumping statistics to log (0 = disabled).

extended_statistics.description: Enable extended statistics (memory usage, thread stats, etc.).

cumulative_statistics.description: Accumulate statistics across restarts (requires persistent storage).

control_enable.description: Enable the local control interface (for `unbound-control` admin commands).

control_interface.description: IP address for the control interface.

control_server_key_file.description: Path to the RSA private key for the control server.

control_server_cert_file.description: Path to the RSA certificate for the control server.

control_client_key_file.description: Path to the RSA private key used by the control client.

control_client_cert_file.description: Path to the RSA certificate used by the control client.
